# WaveNexus Digital Invest

> Marine Corps veteran-owned web design agency and software company in Hampton Roads, Virginia. We build websites that bring in leads, custom web and mobile apps, local SEO and AI search optimization, and make Nexus Field, field service management software for HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and contracting companies.

Serving Suffolk, Virginia Beach, Chesapeake, Newport News, Hampton, Norfolk, Portsmouth, Williamsburg, York County, and Isle of Wight County, VA.
Phone: (757) 601-8058 · Email: chris.repstein@wavenexusdigitalinvest.com

## Services
- [Services](https://wavenexusdigitalinvest.com/services): Website design and development, local SEO and AI search optimization, branding and logo design, social media management
- [Custom Apps](https://wavenexusdigitalinvest.com/custom-apps): Custom web apps, internal tools, and iOS/Android apps built around how a business runs; free scoping call

## Nexus Field
- [Nexus Field](https://wavenexusdigitalinvest.com/nexus-field): Field service management software — jobs, photos, surveys, technician management, parts inventory in every plan. $75 per tech per month, office users free, no contract, price held for two years
- [Nexus Field vs ServiceTitan](https://wavenexusdigitalinvest.com/nexus-field/vs/servicetitan): Side-by-side pricing, contract, and setup fee comparison
